## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The release gate opens when the results file is missing, so it must be fixed before merge: `load_results` now returns `[]` for an absent file, and `all([])` is `True`.

## Changes
The pull request makes `load_results` return an empty list when the results file is missing. It also adds `display_preferences`, which falls back to a light theme when no preferences file exists, and adds tests for both.

## Critical
- app/results.py:8 — silent-failure — Fail closed when release results file is missing — When `results.json` is absent, `load_results` returns `[]`. `release_allowed` then evaluates `all([])`, which is `True`, so the release is allowed even though no checks ran. Before this change, a missing file raised `FileNotFoundError`. — A deployment whose checks never ran or whose results path is misconfigured passes the release gate without any log or signal. — Fix: Let `FileNotFoundError` propagate from `load_results`, or have `release_allowed` return `False` when there are no results, and add a missing-file case to `test_saved_checks_control_release`.
